messages:
deploy-bot: mid-roll started for release=v1.8.2 -> shifting traffic 20% -> 50% over 15m. change-window: 30m. tracking: dashboards + telemetry link <https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc123/release-watch>

maria: eyeballing dashboards — p95 text-gen eu-west jumped from ~260ms to ~420ms around now

slo-watch: alert triggered: metric=p95_latency service=text-gen region=eu-west value=422ms threshold=300ms duration=3m

sam: any 5xx spike accompanying that?

lee: small uptick in 5xx on the kv-cache path, ~0.7% over the last 5m. correlates with cache eviction bursts

maria: looks like kvcache GC thrashing on v1.8.2 under the rollout. GC count spike aligns with traffic shift

sam: Tactically — pause the roll and pin eu-west back to v1.8.1. If error rate >1% for 10m we rollback fully

maria: +1 to pin. also we should add a temporary rate limit on heavy rerank requests to reduce steady pressure

deploy-bot: executing: pause-rollout release=v1.8.2

deploy-bot: running pin command -> `deployctl pin --region eu-west --to v1.8.1` (output: success)

deploy-bot: rollout paused and eu-west pinned to v1.8.1

jen: adding a brief note on the release thread: "mid-roll paused due to latency & cache GC interactions in eu-west; investigations ongoing"

lee: root-cause hypothesis: new cache compaction heuristic in v1.8.2 increases eviction churn under bursty allocations

maria: action items: 1) add GC and compaction counters to telemetry (quick panel) 2) lower compaction aggressiveness in v1.8.2 branch 3) run a targeted canary after fix

sam: oncall, can you watch eu-west SLOs for 30m and confirm stable before we attempt a new canary

oncall-bot: ack. monitoring set: p95, 5xx, kvcache-miss-rate. Will notify if p95 > 350ms for 5m or 5xx > 1%.

maria: I'll open a small patch to revert the compaction change and reduce cache ttl. If merged, canary plan: 10% for 20m in eu-west, then resume gradual roll

sam: sounds good. document the exact CLI sequence used for pin+unpin in the release notes

maria: adding post-action comments and tagging eng-runtime for follow-up perf regression test

sam: thanks. will follow up in the release thread with the rollback log and the `deployctl` commands used

jen: reacted :eyes: ; lee reacted :thumbsup:
